nodes.description: Two routes lead to the same deficit. Most missense substitutions leave a stable recombinant protein with reduced catalytic efficiency, mostly through lower kcat; the reduction ranges from moderate (p.Phe154Leu, p.Thr520Ile) to about 1% of wild type (p.Pro493Leu, p.Tyr729Cys). Other variants, including the c.1423+2T>A splice allele and the variants in the 2023 French series, reduce ELAC2 expression or protein abundance in patient cells. ELAC2 is dual targeted: translation from the first AUG produces the mitochondrial isoform and from the second AUG a nuclear isoform, and the disease mechanism curated here concerns the mitochondrial activity. ELAC2 acts in a complex with the MRPP1/MRPP2 (TRMT10C/HSD17B10) subcomplex, which retains the 5'-processed tRNA and enhances 3' cleavage.
